items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: he pulls me over to him... he takes he on with him... she called me to tell me that he took her on first-class with him

ctx.x: we pass the usual B.S., he was looking good, too -- he'd picked up a few pounds. Anyway, he pulls me over to him and puts these things on my ears, like the Walkman, and he's got a whole raft of songs that he's written parodies to. For instance, he's done one to "Cry Me A River." His parody to that is "Fry Me A River."
Oh, Willie Bobo used to do that, I understand.

Oh, he did? Well, anyhow, he's got, you know, many of them, and he happens to be on his way to Chicago. So to cut the story short, my daughter is on standby, because she changed her reservation, and she's hoping she can get on this flight. So when 12:15 comes and he's getting ready to board, he says, "Well, aren't you going?" She said, "I'm on standby." He said, "no, you're not; you're with me." So he takes he on with him, and she called me to tell me that he took her on first-class with him, and told her things…
